acmic.zh: adj. 顶峰的；与顶点或最高点有关的。
acmic.en: adj. Pertaining to a peak, highest point, or culmination.
acmic.ipaSource: Merriam-Webster Dictionary; respelling converted to IPA using its pronunciation key
acmic.reviewReason: Direct English headword pronunciation and definition are provided by Merriam-Webster; Collins independently gives the respelling ˈækmɪk for acmic as an adjective derived from acme.

alans.zh: n. 猎犬；大型猎犬（alan 的复数）。
alans.en: n. Plural of alan: large hunting dogs, especially wolfhounds.
alans.ipaSource: Webster’s International Dictionary (1907), visually verified wolfhound entry and pronunciation guide; broad IPA conversion plus regular plural /z/
alans.baseIpaSource: Webster’s International Dictionary (1907), p. 35 and guide p. lxi: unstressed a as in arise/sofa, stressed a as in fat, stress on lan; broad IPA /əˈlæn/
alans.relationSource: Merriam-Webster confirms alan (also alaunt/alant) as the archaic large hunting dog and gives plural -s
alans.reviewReason: Parent and independent reviewer visually checked the original 1907 dictionary page, rejecting the OCR initial i. The printed first vowel is the unaccented a used in arise/sofa in the same book, not i as in pin. Guide p. lxi, sections 54 and 61–67, supports short stressed /æ/ and the neutral realization /ə/ for the unstressed vowel. Convert the wolfhound noun to broad IPA /əˈlæn/ and add the attested regular plural /z/; retain derived status.

apos.zh: n. 载脂蛋白（apo 的复数，apo 是 apolipoprotein 的简称）
apos.en: n. Plural of apo, an informal biochemical clipping of apolipoprotein.
apos.ipaSource: American Heritage Dictionary respelling for apo, converted to IPA; regular English plural /z/ added
apos.baseIpaSource: American Heritage Dictionary, respelling a·po (ā′pō), converted to IPA
apos.relationSource: Wiktionary English entries explicitly identify apo as apolipoprotein clipping and apos as its plural
apos.reviewReason: Root pronunciation and the exact English plural relationship are both explicitly attested; derived plural is /ˈeɪpoʊz/.

areae.zh: area 的解剖学复数：器官（包括大脑皮质）中具有特定功能的区域。
areae.en: Plural of area in anatomy: circumscribed regions or functional parts of organs, including the cerebral cortex.
areae.ipaSource: Merriam-Webster English area plus the explicitly attested medical plural ending -e
areae.relationSource: Medical Dictionary: area, plural areae (ar′e-a, -e); English medical -ae pronounced /iː/
areae.zhSource: Medical Dictionary and Taber’s Cyclopedic Medical Dictionary (Chinese adaptation)
areae.enSource: Medical Dictionary; Taber’s Cyclopedic Medical Dictionary (paraphrase)
areae.reviewReason: The medical dictionary gives a plural-specific respelling and the exact functional/anatomical sense. Its notation is converted to IPA retaining the three syllables ar-e-e; Taber independently confirms area (plural areae, areas) in medical anatomy. Parent review: use the attested English root area /ˈɛɹiə/ and the medical plural-ending respelling, retaining the medial /i/; label the result derived rather than a directly published full IPA.

ates.zh: n. 姐姐；对年长女性的尊称（ate 的复数，源自菲律宾用语）
ates.en: n. Plural of ate: elder sisters, or a respectful form of address for older women.
ates.ipaSource: Oxford Advanced Learner’s Dictionary US pronunciation for ate, plus regular English plural /z/
ates.baseIpaSource: Oxford Advanced Learner’s Dictionary US pronunciation of the Philippine English noun ate
ates.relationSource: Wiktionary English entry explicitly identifies ate (plural ates), elder sister/respectful title
ates.reviewReason: The English regional dictionary’s pronunciation matches the English noun sense, and a separate English lexical entry confirms the plural relationship; IPA is transparently derived from the base, not sourced as an exact plural form.

baalim.zh: Baal 的复数；指古代闪族神祇 Baal 的多个地方神祇/形态
baalim.en: Plural of Baal; in biblical and mythological use, local forms or aspects of the ancient Semitic deity.
baalim.reviewReason: Direct plural pronunciation is supplied in Collins for the matching Baal deity sense; no derivation is needed.

beses.zh: bes 的复数：希伯来字母 beth（第二个希伯来字母）的名称或字形。
beses.en: Plural of bes: the Hebrew letter beth.
beses.ipaSource: Derived by regular plural /ɪz/ from Merriam-Webster's ‘ˈbās’ pronunciation of the same Hebrew-letter name, converted using MW's own guide; Scrabble verifies beses as the plural of bes
beses.relationSource: Merriam-Webster Scrabble entry: bes, noun, pl. beses, beth
beses.zhSource: Chinese translation based on Merriam-Webster Scrabble and beth entries
beses.reviewReason: Merriam-Webster Scrabble explicitly gives bes (noun, plural beses) = beth. Merriam-Webster's beth entry defines it as the second Hebrew letter and publishes the pronunciations ‘ˈbāth’, ‘ˈbāt’, ‘ˈbās’ for that entry. The Merriam-Webster pronunciation guide maps ā to the diphthong in ‘day’ (/eɪ/), s to /s/, and the prefixed mark to primary stress, so the complete chosen base respelling ‘ˈbās’ converts to /ˈbeɪs/. Since the same dictionary verifies the real bes → beses relation, regular /ɪz/ pluralization yields derived /ˈbeɪsɪz/. This is explicitly marked derived, not a direct beses recording.

compas.zh: n. 康帕（compas/kompa）音乐：起源于海地的一种流行舞蹈音乐。
compas.en: n. A popular music of Haiti that combines Cuban and African rhythms.
compas.ipaSource: Merriam-Webster pronunciation respelling converted to broad IPA
compas.reviewReason: Merriam-Webster's main dictionary directly supplies the Haitian-music sense and the respelling com·pas kōm-ˈpä. Converting that marked English respelling to broad US IPA gives /koʊmˈpɑ/ (stress on the second syllable); this replaces the unrelated unsupported /ˈkɑmpəs/.

dolci.zh: dolce 的复数：管风琴上一种音色极柔和的笛音音栓。
dolci.en: Plural of dolce: very soft flute pipe-organ stops.
dolci.ipaSource: Webster's New International English Dictionary plural respelling ‘dol·ci -(ˌ)chē’, converted to broad IPA
dolci.zhSource: Chinese translation of Webster's New International English Dictionary noun sense
dolci.reviewReason: Webster's New International English Dictionary explicitly lists the English noun dolce's plural as dolci and prints the plural pronunciation respelling ‘dol·ci -(ˌ)chē’ directly beside the organ-stop sense. Converting the published form (primary stress carried by dol-, ‘ch’ = /tʃ/, ‘ē’ = /i/) to broad IPA gives /ˈdoʊltʃi/; the optional secondary mark on the ending is not shown in this broad form. This is an English dictionary pronunciation, not an Italian pronunciation.

duci.ipaSource: Derived from Collins' American-English singular and explicitly phonetic plural ending -ci (-tʃi)
duci.relationSource: Collins, same English entry: ‘Word forms: plural -ces, -ci (-tʃi)’
duci.zhSource: Chinese translation of Collins American English definition
duci.reviewReason: Collins' American English duce entry defines the word as a leader or dictator, gives singular /ˈduːtʃei/, and explicitly lists ‘Word forms: plural -ces, -ci (-tʃi)’. Combining the dictionary's English stem du- /ˈduː/ with its published plural ending -ci /tʃi/ yields /ˈduːtʃi/. Recorded as derived from the entry's explicit plural pronunciation, not copied from the Italian or unrelated Hungarian/Sicilian entries.

farc.zh: n.（通常大写 FARC）哥伦比亚革命武装力量；其西班牙语名称的首字母缩写。
farc.en: n. FARC: the acronym for Fuerzas Armadas Revolucionarias de Colombia, the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia.
farc.zhSource: Chinese translation of the Collins definition
farc.reviewReason: Collins records FARC as an English acronym for Fuerzas Armadas Revolucionarias de Colombia (Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia), with British pronunciation /fɑːk/. This is an acronym pronounced as a lexicalized spoken form, not letter-by-letter pronunciation. Normalize the gloss to this attested entry; do not preserve the unsupported farce-variant claim.

gighe.zh: giga 的复数：吉格舞或吉格舞曲
gighe.en: Plural of giga: gigues or lively dance movements.
gighe.ipaSource: Webster's New International English Dictionary, GIGA entry; pronunciation key mappings checked against Webster's Secondary-School Dictionary; published plural respelling converted to IPA
gighe.reviewReason: Webster's New International English Dictionary gives the noun giga with the plural respelling explicitly as 'gi·ghe -gā' and defines it as 'gigue'. This is the English dance-word sense, and the respelling is explicitly attached to the plural form. Converting Webster's respelling to broad American English IPA gives /ˈdʒiːɡeɪ/ (first-syllable stress inherited from the headword; j = /dʒ/, ē = /iː/, ā = /eɪ/). This is a respelling-to-IPA conversion, not an IPA transcription published by the source.

inia.zh: n. 亚马孙河豚属的南美洲淡水豚。
inia.en: n. A South American freshwater dolphin of the genus Inia.
inia.ipaSource: The United Editors Perpetual Encyclopedia and Dictionary, vol. 15, respelling converted using its pronunciation key
inia.reviewReason: The United Editors Perpetual Encyclopedia, vol. 15, p. 52（扫描页）将该英语词条写作“INIA, ĭn’ĭ-a”，并释为淡水鲸类。其卷首发音键（扫描页9）定义ĭ为pin中的短元音 /ɪ/，说明重音撇号位于受重读音节之后，连字符用于音节分隔。按其重拼转换为宽式IPA /ˈɪn.ɪ.ə/；末尾无重音 -a 按英语词尾弱读处理。

oig.zh: n. Office of Inspector General 的首字母缩写；特指美国联邦贸易委员会监察长办公室（FTC OIG）。
oig.en: n. Initialism for Office of Inspector General; specifically, the investigative arm of the Federal Trade Commission.
oig.ipaSource: Dictionary.com letter-name pronunciations for O, I, and G; O-I-G is spelled out as individual English letter names.
oig.baseIpaSource: Dictionary.com letter entries O, I, G; Cambridge pronunciation entry for gee
oig.relationSource: OIG is an initialism, expanded by official FTC terminology and Open English WordNet
oig.zhSource: Open English WordNet 2025 (definition) and official FTC terminology (office expansion)
oig.enSource: Open English WordNet 2025 and official FTC terminology
oig.reviewReason: The official OEWN dataset has a single OIG lemma (oewn-OIG-n), with synset oewn-08368307-n, defined as ‘the investigative arm of the Federal Trade Commission.’ The FTC’s official pages expand OIG as Office of Inspector General and describe its audits and investigations. The previous Scots sense has no independently verified supporting entry in this review; that lack of evidence does not establish that the sense is nonexistent. The pronunciation is derived from English letter names O-I-G.

renate.zh: a. 再生的；复苏的（罕用）。
renate.en: a. Born again or renewed, obsolete.
renate.ipaSource: Chambers’s Twentieth Century Dictionary (1908), respelling converted to IPA
renate.reviewReason: Chambers’s Twentieth Century Dictionary (1908) 将renate明确标为英语形容词并给出“rē-nāt′”；按该辞典英语重拼将ē转为 /iː/、ā转为 /eɪ/，保留其标示的末音节重音，转写为 /riːˈneɪt/。

uma.zh: n. 乌玛，印度教女神帕尔瓦蒂的别名。
uma.en: n. Uma, a name of the Hindu goddess Parvati.
uma.ipaSource: U*X*L Encyclopedia of World Mythology (English respelling OO-ma converted to IPA)
uma.reviewReason: U*X*L Encyclopedia of World Mythology 的英语Devi条目在同一段给出“as Uma (pronounced OO-ma)”及其神名义。按英语常见重拼将OO转为 /uː/，末尾弱读a转为 /ə/，首音节为重读，得 /ˈuːmə/。该来源对应女神义，不依赖Sanskrit/Hindi发音。
